name: proto-forge
description: Turn a product brief into production-grade code with zero placeholders: a React 19 + TypeScript + Vite web app, a backend service in Node (Fastify), Java (Spring Boot) or Python (FastAPI) with the architecture derived from the brief's complexity, or both composed as one workspace with an OpenAPI contract and a cross-app e2e layer — plus a SPIN/DAPA discovery skill. Every template ships full tests behind mutation gates, auto-generated quality status, doctor and tiered self-healing, a strict security + delivery baseline (environments, digest-pinned containers, Helm for OpenShift/AKS) and a pnpm verify gate suite.
